about: Inflame Appliances Ltd is an integrated kitchen-appliance manufacturer focused predominantly on OEM/ODM supply to Indian consumer brands, alongside its own Inflame brand. It manufactures electrical chimneys, built-in hobs, gas stoves, cooktops, and premium built-in appliances at facilities in Panchkula and Hyderabad. [1]
